query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, i.companyName, i.meetingPackage, i.isTest
FROM users u
JOIN intakeSubmissions i ON i.sponsorId = u.id
WHERE u.role = 'user' AND (i.isTest = 0 OR i.isTest IS NULL)
ORDER BY u.id;
